comment:
* This class will abstract away all the new enablement logic and take the reset/enable/disable
 * IMS commands as inputs.
 * The IMS commands will call enableIms, disableIms or resetIms to match the enablement state only
 * when it changes.

variables.name: COMMAND_ENABLE_MSG
variables.comment: Indicate that the enableIms command has been received.

variables.name: COMMAND_DISABLE_MSG
variables.comment: Indicate that the disableIms command has been received.

variables.name: COMMAND_RESET_MSG
variables.comment: Indicate that the resetIms command has been received.

variables.name: COMMAND_ENABLING_DONE
variables.comment: Indicate that the internal enable message with delay has been received.

variables.name: COMMAND_DISABLING_DONE
variables.comment: Indicate that the internal disable message with delay has been received.

variables.name: COMMAND_RESETTING_DONE
variables.comment: Indicate that the internal reset message with delay has been received.

variables.name: COMMAND_INVALID_SUBID_MSG
variables.comment: The subId is changed to INVALID_SUBSCRIPTION_ID.

variables.name: COMMAND_POST_RESETTING_DONE
variables.comment: Indicate that the internal post reset message with delay has been received.

methods.name: public void setNumOfSlots(int numOfSlots)
methods.comment:
* Set the number of SIM slots.
     * @param numOfSlots the number of SIM slots.

methods.name: public boolean isState(int slotId, int state)
methods.comment:
* Check that the current state and the input state are the same.
     * @param state the input state.
     * @return true if the current state and input state are the same or false.

methods.name: public void subIdChangedToInvalid(int slotId)
methods.comment:
* Notify the state machine that the subId has changed to invalid.
     * @param slotId subscription id

methods.name: public void enableIms(int slotId, int subId)
methods.comment:
* Notify ImsService to enable IMS for the framework. This will trigger IMS registration and
     * trigger ImsFeature status updates.
     * @param slotId slot id
     * @param subId subscription id

methods.name: public void disableIms(int slotId, int subId)
methods.comment:
* Notify ImsService to disable IMS for the framework. This will trigger IMS de-registration and
     * trigger ImsFeature capability status to become false.
     * @param slotId slot id
     * @param subId subscription id

methods.name: public void resetIms(int slotId, int subId)
methods.comment:
* Notify ImsService to reset IMS for the framework. This will trigger ImsService to perform
     * de-registration and release all resource. After that, if enaleIms is called, the ImsService
     * performs registration and appropriate initialization to bring up all ImsFeatures.
     * @param slotId slot id
     * @param subId subscription id

methods.name: public long getRemainThrottleTime()
methods.comment:
* Get remaining throttle time value
     * @return remaining throttle time value

methods.name: private boolean isServiceControllerAvailable()
methods.comment:
* Check to see if the service controller is available.
     * @return true if available, false otherwise

methods.name: private void sendEnableIms(int slotId, int subId)
private void sendDisableIms(int slotId, int subId)
private void sendResetIms(int slotId, int subId)
